name: lychee_section
title: 荔枝横截面:背光、湿面
what: objects/lychee's cut fruit, its cut face to the camera: backlit.json's through lamp and rims for the tubercles' glowing tips; a broad softbox above the lens for the lobes' tops; a low strip under the lens, where the vertical wet face mirrors; a dark red ground lit faintly.

shots.what: lychee flesh, rim of red tubercles

look_target.note: a look target for the light only

spectrum.why: our choice (S4, toward the look target's warm cream and crimson): every lamp 4000 K, the camera balanced for 5500 K (the recipe's develop.white_balance), as a photographer warms a shot with the light

lamps.name: through
lamps.why: backlit.json's through lamp, lower (dz -0.35 R): looking 8 degrees down over a half fruit, the default showed above the arc

lamps.name: rim_left
lamps.why: as backlit.json, a little lower and wider apart: the tubercles' tips lit through from behind

lamps.name: top
lamps.why: our choice: a broad softbox above the lens; the sacs' domes catch it on their upper flanks

lamps.name: side_left
lamps.why: our choice (S4 v6, in place of a strip under the lens): a pair of softboxes level with the face, 35 degrees off the lens to either side. They light the vertical cut face (cos 35 = 0.82) and graze the skin's upper surface, so the flesh is lit while the rim stays crimson. The flat face mirrors them away from the lens, so only flanks tilted 12-23 degrees sideways (the sacs' domes by their creases, the beads) glint, in lines, as in the look target; v5's strip under the lens made every flat patch of juice a white blot

lamps.name: side_right
lamps.why: our choice (S4 v6, in place of a strip under the lens): a pair of softboxes level with the face, 35 degrees off the lens to either side. They light the vertical cut face (cos 35 = 0.82) and graze the skin's upper surface, so the flesh is lit while the rim stays crimson. The flat face mirrors them away from the lens, so only flanks tilted 12-23 degrees sideways (the sacs' domes by their creases, the beads) glint, in lines, as in the look target; v5's strip under the lens made every flat patch of juice a white blot

lamps.name: ground
lamps.why: as backlit.json: lights the ground seen behind the fruit

backdrop.why: our choice: a dark red ground, far back (20 R: the rims' and the strip's spill falls off ~2.6 stops more than at 8 R) and lit faintly, for the look target's maroon dark (bg 28, 0, 1)
